description: Understand Django middleware and create custom ones

slides.title: What is Middleware?
slides.content:
# Django Middleware ⚙️

Middleware processes requests/responses globally!

## Request/Response Cycle

```
Request → Middleware → View → Middleware → Response
              ↓           ↓         ↑
          process_request  →  process_response
```

## Default Middleware

```python
# settings.py
MIDDLEWARE = [
    'django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware',
    'django.contrib.sessions.middleware.SessionMiddleware',
    'django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware',
    'django.middleware.csrf.CsrfViewMiddleware',
    'django.contrib.auth.middleware.AuthenticationMiddleware',
    'django.contrib.messages.middleware.MessageMiddleware',
]
```

> 💡 **Order matters!** Middleware runs top-to-bottom for requests, bottom-to-top for responses.

slides.title: Custom Middleware
slides.content:
# Creating Custom Middleware 🛠️

## Function-Based

```python
def simple_middleware(get_response):
    def middleware(request):
        # Code before view
        print(f"Request: {request.path}")
        
        response = get_response(request)  # Call view
        
        # Code after view
        print(f"Response: {response.status_code}")
        return response
    
    return middleware
```

## Class-Based

```python
class TimingMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response
    
    def __call__(self, request):
        import time
        start = time.time()
        
        response = self.get_response(request)
        
        duration = time.time() - start
        print(f"Request took {duration:.2f}s")
        return response
```

## Register in settings.py

```python
MIDDLEWARE = [
    # ...
    'myapp.middleware.TimingMiddleware',
]
```

slides.title: Summary
slides.content:
# Great Work! 🎉

You've learned Django Middleware!

## Key Points
- ✅ Middleware processes ALL requests/responses
- ✅ Order in MIDDLEWARE list matters
- ✅ Create function or class-based middleware
- ✅ Register in settings.py

## Use Cases
- 📝 Logging requests
- ⏱️ Performance timing
- 🔐 Custom authentication
- 🌍 Language detection
